name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The pizza features a charred crust, topped with a red sauce, melted white cheese, and fresh green basil leaves. It is cut into four slices, with one slice partially pulled away from the rest. The pizza is presented on a round wooden board with a handle.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish consists of grilled chicken pieces in a rich, creamy tomato-based sauce, garnished with fresh cilantro and served in a decorative metal bowl. The sauce has a vibrant orange-red hue and appears to be slightly steaming. It is accompanied by a bowl of white rice and naan bread on the side.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: The dish is a stir-fry featuring cubed tofu and various vegetables, including broccoli, carrots, and snap peas, in a savory brown sauce. The ingredients are cooked and presented in a white bowl, accompanied by a side of white rice in a smaller bowl. The stir-fry is generously portioned and artfully arranged.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The salad is composed of lettuce, sliced tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese, all lightly seasoned with black pepper. A silver serving spoon is partially submerged in the salad, which is served in a large white bowl. The ingredients appear to be raw and uncooked, with no visible cooking style or heat treatment.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The dish is a generous serving of spaghetti tossed in a light-colored sauce, topped with grated cheese and garnished with chopped parsley and visible garlic slices. The pasta is presented in a white bowl, with a sprinkle of red pepper flakes visible on the noodles. The presentation is simple yet appetizing, with a fork placed to the side of the bowl.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: The glazed salmon is presented on a wooden cutting board, sliced into thick portions and topped with a shiny glaze, fresh dill, and mustard seeds. A fork is inserted into one of the slices, and a small glass bowl containing the glaze is placed beside the salmon, accompanied by lemon wedges. The dish is garnished with additional dill sprigs and scattered spices around the cutting board.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The Tomato Basil Soup is a vibrant red-orange color and is garnished with fresh basil leaves and herbs. The soup is served in a light blue ceramic bowl with a brown rim, and is accompanied by various ingredients such as a red chili pepper, garlic cloves, and a small bowl of cream or yogurt. The dish is presented on a light gray surface, surrounded by additional ingredients and garnishes, including a whole tomato, olive oil, and salt.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The dish is a stir-fry noodle dish featuring rice noodles, shrimp, scrambled eggs, bean sprouts, and green onions, garnished with a lime wedge and whole shrimp on top. The ingredients are mixed together and presented in a large, shallow ceramic bowl. The dish is accompanied by various garnishes and seasonings, including sliced garlic, chili flakes, and spices, arranged around the bowl on a wooden table.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The dish consists of seven crispy, golden-brown falafel patties, garnished with fresh parsley and served with sliced red onions and a lemon wedge on a decorative plate. The falafel appears to be deep-fried, with visible seasonings and herbs mixed into the chickpea mixture. The dish is presented with a side of creamy tahini sauce in a small bowl, accompanied by various ingredients and spices.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: The image shows four tacos filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, diced tomatoes, salsa verde, and sour cream, all wrapped in yellow corn tortillas. The tacos are arranged on a dark plate, surrounded by various toppings and condiments, including additional salsa, sour cream, and shredded cheese in small bowls. The dish is garnished with lime wedges and chopped peppers, adding a pop of color to the presentation.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image shows a pan-seared ribeye steak, cooked to medium-rare and sliced into thick strips, served in a cast-iron skillet with melted butter and sprigs of thyme. The steak is accompanied by three cubes of butter on the right side of the skillet. The dish is presented with various seasonings and ingredients surrounding the skillet, including peppercorns, salt, garlic cloves, and a small glass bowl of oil.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant, orange-red lentil stew garnished with fresh cilantro, sliced onions, halved cherry tomatoes, and a lime wedge. The stew is served in a ceramic bowl and appears to be cooked in a tomato-based sauce with visible lentils and spices. The presentation is enhanced by the surrounding ingredients and garnishes, including a small bowl of turmeric powder, whole onions, and garlic cloves.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: The dish consists of a glazed cod fillet served on a bed of white rice, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, and accompanied by a savory sauce. The cod appears to be pan-seared or grilled, with a caramelized glaze on top. The meal is presented in a ceramic bowl with a blue-green glaze, paired with a side of additional white rice and a small bowl of soy sauce or similar condiment.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: The image shows a platter of four roasted chicken pieces, likely legs and thighs, glazed with a dark brown sauce and garnished with rosemary sprigs and minced garlic. The chicken is arranged on a round wooden platter, surrounded by lime wedges and accompanied by various side dishes, including rice, beans, and a bowl of sauce.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The dish features penne pasta tossed with roasted cherry tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and shaved parmesan cheese, all seasoned with black pepper. The ingredients are artfully arranged on a ceramic plate with a brown rim and blue interior, creating a visually appealing presentation. The generous portion is surrounded by scattered ingredients and cooking elements, such as cherry tomatoes on the vine and a bulb of garlic.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant orange-red curry featuring tender cubes of paneer, garnished with fresh herbs and thinly sliced onions. The curry is presented in a large, shallow bowl with a generous portion size. The paneer is cooked in a rich, saucy gravy, accompanied by visible seasonings and spices scattered around the bowl.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: The dessert drink consists of layered ingredients, including red jelly cubes at the bottom, followed by thin noodles, and topped with a white cream and a red syrup drizzle. The glasses are garnished with cherries, rose petals, and mint leaves, and accompanied by decorative spoons, with additional ingredients such as noodles and rose petals visible in the surrounding bowls and on the serving tray.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The Shakshuka is a vibrant dish featuring eggs poached in a rich, red sauce with visible ingredients including sliced red and green peppers, onions, and tomatoes, all cooked in a black skillet. The dish is garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by a wooden spoon holding peppercorns. The presentation is rustic, with the skillet centered among various bowls of spices, herbs, and other ingredients on a gray surface.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The dish consists of a generous serving of white rice surrounded by dark brown beans, garnished with sliced garlic and two green leaves, all presented on a white plate. The beans appear to be cooked in a savory sauce, as evidenced by the visible liquid at the base of the plate. The overall presentation is simple, with the ingredients arranged in a straightforward manner.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The dish features thinly sliced, medium-rare beef, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions, served on top of onions in a shallow bowl. The beef appears to be cooked and marinated, with a glossy appearance. The plating is simple, with the beef arranged in a circular pattern, and is accompanied by various seasonings and ingredients surrounding the bowl.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The 'Spanish Paella Valenciana' is a savory rice dish cooked in a large, shallow pan, featuring chicken pieces, halved cherry tomatoes, and onions, with a yellow-orange hue from saffron or spices. The dish is garnished with rosemary sprigs and red chili peppers, and is presented in a rustic, metal pan with handles on either side. The ingredients are arranged in a visually appealing pattern, with the chicken pieces radiating from the center of the pan.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: The dish is a steaming bowl of soup featuring large shrimp, sliced red chilies, mushrooms, and stalks of lemongrass, all garnished with cilantro and a lime wedge. The ingredients are arranged in a white ceramic bowl, accompanied by a white spoon. The broth is a vibrant orange hue with visible red chili flakes.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The salad consists of romaine lettuce, croutons, halved cherry tomatoes, shaved parmesan cheese, and sliced grilled chicken breast, all tossed in a creamy dressing. The chicken is cooked with visible grill marks and seasoned with black pepper. The dish is presented in a bowl, garnished with additional shaved parmesan cheese on top.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: The dish is a layered casserole featuring sliced eggplant, ground meat, and a rich tomato sauce, topped with a creamy bechamel sauce and baked until golden brown. The ingredients are neatly arranged in a square baking dish, showcasing a harmonious balance of textures and colors. Fresh herbs garnish the top, adding a pop of green to the presentation.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of ramen, featuring a rich, light-brown broth with noodles, sliced meat, green onions, black sesame seeds, and halved soft-boiled eggs. The ingredients are arranged neatly in a black bowl, with the noodles on the left, sliced meat on the right, and garnishes scattered around the top. The dish is presented in a visually appealing manner, with a clear broth and a variety of textures and colors.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The dish is a generous serving of cooked shrimp and fettuccine pasta, mixed with sliced green beans and lemon, and seasoned with herbs and spices. The shrimp are pink and appear to be sautéed, while the pasta is lightly coated in a sauce. The dish is garnished with lemon slices and presented in a shallow, speckled ceramic bowl.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant vegetable stew, featuring sliced zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, red bell peppers, and onions, garnished with fresh herbs. The ingredients are cooked together in a large white bowl, showcasing a colorful and appetizing presentation. The surrounding ingredients, including whole vegetables and spices, suggest a hearty and flavorful meal.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: The image shows two pieces of pan-seared salmon, seasoned with black pepper and garnished with fresh dill, served on a plate with a side of creamy dill yogurt sauce. The dish is accompanied by lemon wedges and presented on a rustic plate with a napkin underneath, alongside a fork and knife.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant and colorful Thai Green Curry with Vegetables, featuring a medley of sautéed vegetables, including zucchini, bell peppers, and snow peas, alongside cubed tofu, all simmered in a rich green curry sauce. The curry is served with a side of white rice, and garnished with fresh basil leaves and sliced chilies. The ingredients are artfully arranged in a bowl, accompanied by wooden chopsticks and a spoon.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The dish is presented in a bowl on a blue plate, consisting of white sticky rice topped with diced mango, a drizzle of orange sauce, and garnished with green leaves. The ingredients are also displayed separately, including sliced mango, a bowl of orange sauce, and small bowls of white salt. The overall presentation is visually appealing, with the dish and its components arranged artfully on the plate and surrounding surface.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The 'Herbed Quinoa Salad' is a vibrant and fresh mix of cooked quinoa, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, and parsley, presented in a white bowl. The ingredients appear to be lightly seasoned with various peppercorns and are arranged in a visually appealing manner. The dish is accompanied by lemon wedges and a small bowl of yellow dressing on the surrounding gray surface.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The 'Beef Shawarma Wrap' is a large flour tortilla filled with sliced cooked beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and lettuce. The ingredients are neatly arranged within the wrap, which is tied with twine. Various accompaniments, including sauces and additional vegetables, are visible around the wrap.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: The dish consists of four seared chicken breasts on a bed of noodles, topped with melted cheese and surrounded by cherry tomatoes, all baked in a green pesto sauce. The ingredients are arranged in a baking dish, with a spoonful of pesto sauce visible in a wooden spoon beside it. The presentation is appetizing, with the golden-brown chicken and vibrant tomatoes adding to the visual appeal.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The Baked Eggplant Parmesan is a layered dish featuring breaded and baked eggplant slices topped with marinara sauce and melted cheese, presented in a rectangular baking dish. The dish is garnished with herbs and has a generous amount of shredded cheese on top. The surrounding ingredients include bowls of marinara sauce, grated cheese, and various vegetables such as tomatoes and onions.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: The Moroccan Chickpea Stew is a hearty, slow-cooked dish presented in a decorative ceramic bowl, filled with chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and garnished with fresh cilantro. The stew's reddish-brown broth and visible ingredients suggest a rich, flavorful profile. The bowl is placed on a wooden surface, surrounded by complementary ingredients and cooking elements.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The Crunchy Cabbage Slaw is a salad composed of shredded green cabbage and carrots, mixed with black pepper, and presented in a large blue bowl. The ingredients are visible around the bowl, including shredded carrots, chopped cabbage, mayonnaise, and various seasonings. The dish appears to be uncooked, with a raw and crunchy texture.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The dish is a bowl of raw fish marinated in citrus juices, mixed with sliced red onions, halved red chili peppers, and garnished with cilantro. The ingredients are arranged in a visually appealing manner, with a lime wedge on top. The bowl is placed on a wooden cutting board, surrounded by additional ingredients and seasonings.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The dish consists of stir-fried chicken, Thai basil leaves, and sliced red chilies, served with a generous portion of white rice on a decorative plate. The chicken is cooked in a savory sauce and mixed with various ingredients, creating a vibrant and appetizing presentation. The plate is garnished with additional Thai basil leaves and a red chili pepper, adding to the overall visual appeal.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The image shows a plate of sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese, garnished with fresh basil leaves and drizzled with olive oil and balsamic glaze. The ingredients are arranged in an overlapping pattern on a white plate, creating a visually appealing composition. The dish is presented on a wooden board, accompanied by a fork and a small bowl of balsamic glaze.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image shows a pan of risotto with a heart-shaped mixture of cooked pumpkin and raw diced pumpkin, topped with thinly sliced red onions and a pat of butter, with a spoon resting in the pan. The dish is presented in a large, dark-colored pan surrounded by various ingredients, including a whole pumpkin, shallots, garlic, salt, and butter.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The dish is a pan-seared shrimp recipe, featuring succulent pink shrimp cooked in a rich, golden sauce infused with garlic and herbs. The sauce appears to be a butter-based emulsion, likely flavored with lemon and herbs, as suggested by the surrounding ingredients, including lemon wedges and a bowl of melted butter.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The dish is a beige-colored dip, likely hummus, garnished with a spiral pattern of olive oil, red pepper flakes, and coarse salt. A roasted red pepper slice is placed in the center, surrounded by chickpeas, and three red chili peppers are arranged on top, creating a visually appealing presentation. The dip is served in a dark bowl, accompanied by pita bread and various ingredients, including peppers and garlic cloves, on a wooden table.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: The image shows a plate of five pieces of naan bread, topped with garlic cloves and herbs, arranged in a circular pattern around a small bowl of garlic butter. name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish is a rich, red curry with large chunks of marinated chicken, onions, and herbs, served in a blue bowl. name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: The Coconut Curry Lentil Soup is a vibrant orange-yellow color, topped with a swirl of white cream, red chili peppers, and small green herbs. The lentils are visible beneath the surface, and the dish is garnished with black seeds and onions, served in a dark brown ceramic bowl.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: The Gyro Wrap is a pita filled with sliced meat, likely lamb or beef, and topped with tomato, cucumber, red onion, and a dollop of white sauce, possibly tzatziki. name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: The image shows a roasted chicken, broken down into its constituent parts, arranged on a large clay platter. The chicken is golden brown with visible seasonings and herbs, surrounded by slices of lime and dried orange.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: The image shows a plate of grilled chicken breasts topped with a vibrant mango salsa, featuring diced mango, red onion, and red pepper, and garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges. The chicken breasts are arranged on a white plate with a brown rim, surrounded by a light orange sauce and additional salsa ingredients. The dish is presented on a dark gray surface, with scattered cilantro leaves adding a pop of color to the scene.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: The image showcases a platter of rice paper rolls, accompanied by a bowl of peanut dip, garnished with sesame seeds and mint leaves. The dish is presented with chopsticks and additional ingredients, including tofu and basil leaves, on a gray surface.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: The Beef Nachos are presented on a large metal platter, topped with a generous portion of tortilla chips smothered in melted cheese, seasoned ground beef, and beans. The dish is garnished with sliced jalapeños and cherry tomatoes, and a dollop of sour cream is placed in the center.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: The image shows a plate of grilled chicken skewers, garnished with rosemary and onions, and seasoned with salt and pepper. name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: The Coconut Shrimp Curry is a vibrant dish featuring succulent shrimp, sliced onions, green chilies, and red bell peppers, all cooked in a rich yellow curry sauce within a large pan. name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto

image_description: The dish is a vibrant and appetizing arrangement of succulent shrimp, steamed broccoli florets, and walnuts, all presented in a blue ceramic bowl. The shrimp are coated in a rich, creamy sauce and topped with a drizzle of mayonnaise or a similar condiment. The ingredients are artfully arranged, with the shrimp piled high in the center of the bowl and the broccoli and walnuts scattered throughout, creating a visually appealing composition.
